arguments.code:
# Update alarms: move 'Go to sleep' 1 hour later and disable all other enabled alarms

# Identify alarms from previously fetched list
# (alarm_id: 120 Wake Up, 121 Wake Up, 122 Go to sleep, 123/124/125 disabled already, 126 Pick up Laundry enabled)

go_to_sleep_id = 122
new_time = '22:30'

# Disable others that are currently enabled: 120, 121, 126
ids_to_disable = [120, 121, 126]

# 1) Move go-to-sleep time only
res1 = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=go_to_sleep_id, access_token=phone_token, time=new_time)
print('update_go_to_sleep',res1)

# 2) Disable other enabled alarms
for aid in ids_to_disable:
    res = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=aid, access_token=phone_token, enabled=False)
    print('disable_alarm',aid,res)

# Re-fetch alarms to verify
alarms=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=phone_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('verification_total',len(alarms))
for a in sorted(alarms, key=lambda x: x.get('alarm_id')):
    print(a.get('alarm_id'),a.get('time'),a.get('label'),a.get('enabled'),a.get('repeat_days'))
